title: QTUNER: A Feature-Guided Adaptive Framework for Quantum-Compiler Optimization Pass Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2607.04586v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum compiler optimization is important for improving the execution fidelity of quantum circuits. In practice, this optimization is often formulated as reducing circuit-level metrics. In classical compilers, pass tuning has been well-established through various methods. However, these methods cannot be directly applied to quantum compilers, because quantum programs exhibit quantum-specific features. Existing quantum compiler tuning studies have attempted to incorporate quantum circuit features with compiler tuning techniques, but they still suffer from two key limitations. First, they tune only a limited subset of optimization passes, leaving the global effectiveness of the full optimization pass space underexplored. Second, the quantum features they use are mainly static features, such as structure and DAG features, which are not directly tied to the optimization characteristics of quantum circuits. translated_title: QTUNER：一种用于量子编译器优化Pass调优的特征引导自适应框架
translated_abstract: 量子编译器优化对于提升量子电路的执行保真度至关重要。在实践中，这种优化通常被表述为降低电路层面的度量指标。在经典编译器领域，Pass调优已通过多种方法得到充分确立。然而，这些方法无法直接应用于量子编译器，因为量子程序表现出量子特有的特征。现有的量子编译器调优研究已尝试将量子电路特征与编译器调优技术相结合，但仍然存在两个关键局限：首先，它们仅调优有限的优化Pass子集，导致整个优化Pass空间的全局有效性尚未得到充分探索；其次，它们所使用的量子特征主要是静态特征（如结构和DAG特征），这些特征与量子电路的优化特性没有直接关联。在本文中，我们提出（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出QTUNER，一种特征引导的自适应框架，通过引入与优化特性直接相关的量子特征来对量子编译器的完整优化Pass空间进行自适应调优，以克服现有方法仅调优有限Pass子集且依赖静态特征的局限，从而提升量子电路的执行保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QTUNER, a feature-guided adaptive framework that leverages quantum-specific features to adaptively tune the full optimization pass space of quantum compilers, overcoming the limitations of existing methods that tune only a limited pass subset and rely on static features.
